prompt_en: A single blue porcelain teacup on a dark kitchen counter shows clearly visible glaze reflections. Soft side lighting from a window travels across the curved glaze and separates its rim from the counter. Its handle and circular mouth remain legible within the same quiet still life. A gradual falloff leaves the rear counter subdued. The frame gives the cup surface priority over surrounding counter space.
